verdict.rationale: The pack documents a REST API, Python and JavaScript libraries, and a subset of the OpenAI and Anthropic APIs. None of these items say that generated tokens can be streamed back incrementally (for example via a stream flag, SSE, or chunked responses). The existence of an API is only adjacent evidence and does not show token streaming, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream generated tokens back to my application as they are produced
